info.name: Traktor Kontrol S8
info.author: openDJ
info.description: openDJ's partial HID mapping for the Traktor Kontrol S8: two deck sections played as in Traktor (effect units, stems on the performance faders, hot cue, loop, slicer and sample pads, touch strips, transport) and the four-channel mixer. Written from an incomplete published HID report layout: the browse and loop encoders don't turn anything yet. Its displays stay dark.
